name: fly-io
description: Fly.io integration — list, inspect, start, stop, restart, and destroy Fly Machines for an app through the Fly.io Machines REST API using an app-scoped API token.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Fly.io Machines — start, stop, restart, and destroy app machines

fields.label: API Token
fields.helpText: A Fly API token (run `fly tokens create`). An app-scoped deploy token is recommended.

fields.label: App Name
fields.helpText: The Fly app these machines belong to, e.g. my-app.

tools.name: fly.list_machines
tools.description: List the machines for a Fly app, with their state, region, and image.

appName.description: Fly app name (falls back to the configured app)

tools.name: fly.get_machine
tools.description: Get a single Fly machine by id, with its state, region, and image.

appName.description: Fly app name (falls back to the configured app)
Fly app name (falls back to the configured app)
Fly app name (falls back to the configured app)
Fly app name (falls back to the configured app)

tools.name: fly.destroy_machine
tools.description: Permanently destroy a Fly machine. This is not reversible.

appName.description: Fly app name (falls back to the configured app)

force.description: Force destroy even if the machine is running (default false)
